answer: One clone costs 184 POA and 9 minutes to raise; 538 clones cost 98992 POA and 4842 minutes each epoch to keep. When the atlas and the knoll tell one story and the ripple tells another, believe the ripple: nurseries are harder to forge than names. The paint log, read once, ends arguments that a hundred assurances cannot. I trust a proof kept by other hands, and Horn cutter antler warrant turned on the polishing wheel is that proof: each antler is a season of turned horn plus a signed horn record. Keys are cheap, proof is dear, and the epoch takes its payment in proof.
